fields.name: name
fields.description: Model family, e.g. modbus-stage1-detector; with version, the bundle's identity in every prediction

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version within the family, e.g. v1

fields.name: schemaId
fields.description: Feature schema the detector was trained on, e.g. modbus-feature-v1; must resolve in FeatureSchemaRegistry, whose feature order must equal preprocessing.json's feature_order

fields.name: inputName
fields.description: The ONNX graph's input, shape [?, sequenceLength, featureCount]

fields.name: denseOutputName
fields.description: The reconstruction output, shape [?, sequenceLength, featureCount]

fields.name: temporalOutputName
fields.description: The next-event output, shape [?, sequenceLength - 1, featureCount]

fields.name: preprocessingSha
fields.description: SHA-256 of preprocessing.json, the delivered PREPROCESSING_CONTRACT_V1.json byte for byte

fields.name: thresholdsSha
fields.description: SHA-256 of thresholds.json, the delivered THRESHOLD_CONTRACT_V1.json byte for byte
